关于此工作流程：视频转 3D 视频 (Qwen-Edit 2509)

此工作流程的目的是使用 Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 创建视频

将每一帧转换成sbs帧，最终是

仅以立体 3D 形式组合到同一视频中。

工作流程中提供了所用模型和教程的下载链接

只需按照工作流程注释（演练）中描述的步骤进行操作即可。

它还继承了原始文件的音频。

这是一个三合一工作流程。

这是一个三合一工作流程。

About this Workflow: Video to 3D Video (Qwen-Edit 2509)

This workflows purpose is to create a video using Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 to

transform each frame into sbs-frames that in the end is

put together into the same video only in stereoscopic 3D.

Download links for the models used and turorials are provided in the workflow

Just follow the steps described in the workflow's note (Walkthough).

It also carries over the audio of the original file.

It is a 3-in-1 Workflow.

About this Workflow: Video to 3D Video (Flux.2 9B)

This workflows purpose is to create a video using Flux to

transform each frame into sbs-frames that in the end is

put together into the same video only in stereoscopic 3D.

It also carries over the audio of the original file.

It is a 3-in-1 Workflow.

Just follow the steps described in the workflow's note (Walkthough).

About this Workflow: Image to 3D Image (Flux.2 9B)

This workflows only purpose is to accomodate the

Stereoscopic-SBS-3D-Image Lora referenced below.

I Just wanted to give an example workflow.

It wasn't my intention to reduce custom nodes usage.

Please checkout the Lora-Description for more infos.
